lines.zh: 我走在队伍中间，骨头让路。
lines.en: I walk at the center; the bones make way.
Black bone passes, and the grass withers behind.

lines.zh: 我的脚步比随从沉得多。
lines.en: My tread falls far heavier than my servants'.

lines.zh: 猎队为我开路，我只管走。
lines.en: The hunt clears the path; I only walk it.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，土都是灰的。
lines.en: Where I pass, the soil turns ashen gray.

lines.zh: 随从跟着我，像一串影子。
lines.en: My servants trail me like a string of shadows.

lines.zh: 夜里的风替我卷起衣袖。
lines.en: Night wind rolls up my sleeves for me.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，近处就暗一点。
lines.en: Each step I take dims the nearby air.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，那是我的鼓点。
lines.en: My bones rattle; that is my drumbeat.

lines.zh: 前面有活人的味道，走过去。
lines.en: There is living scent ahead; I go that way.

lines.zh: 我从不在同一处停太久。
lines.en: I never linger long in any one place.

lines.zh: 这一路，脚踝骨磨得发亮。
lines.en: My ankle bones have worn bright on this road.
My servants stand; so I need not move.

lines.zh: 我在听猎人什么时候犯错。
lines.en: I listen for the moment the hunter errs.
This body is on loan from the wither.
Black bone neither breathes nor hurries.

lines.zh: 我等他们先把随从清掉。
lines.en: I wait for them to clear my servants first.
Rot is the only scent I still give off.
The night is long; my patience is longer.

lines.zh: 骨头围着我，像一圈篱笆。
lines.en: My bones ring me like a fence of white.

lines.zh: 我摸了一下自己的颈骨。
lines.en: I run a hand along my own neck bone.

lines.zh: 沉默是猎前最响的声音。
lines.en: Silence is the loudest sound before a hunt.
Have you counted my servants yet?
Your pupils shrank; I saw the fear arrive.
A living man standing is just a banner.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼眶里什么也没有。
lines.en: I stare with nothing at all inside these sockets.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲很新，声音很响。
lines.en: Your armor is new and much too loud.
I remember that particular look of yours.
Which of us do you plan to kill first?
Do not watch me; watch them.

lines.zh: 你的手在剑柄上出汗了。
lines.en: Your hand is sweating on that sword hilt.
I know the stance of a hunted thing.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍进了我的颈骨。
lines.en: That blade bit into the bone of my neck.
I am split, but I have not scattered yet.

lines.zh: 随从会替我记住这一击。
lines.en: My servants will remember that blow for me.

lines.zh: 痛感很钝，像隔着一层土。
lines.en: The pain is dull, like hearing it through soil.

lines.zh: 你打偏了，我的心脏早没了。
lines.en: You missed; my heart left long ago.
I give half a step; the ranks hold.
Split bone gives off one sharp little sound.
The harder you strike, the quieter I get.

lines.zh: 这一刀的利息，用头骨还。
lines.en: The interest on that cut is paid in skulls.
One corner of black bone broke; still usable.
Whatever you are raising, I do not eat it.
A great spirit needs no feeding.
Bribing the dead with food is naive.
My stomach turned into a hollow long ago.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，会烂得更快。
lines.en: The meat in your hand will rot faster than you.
I am summoned, never lured.
Put it away; that smell stings my skull.
Feed me and my servants will snatch it first.
I have no tongue left to taste with.
Do not waste it; save it for the living.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，指尖立刻发凉。
lines.en: You bumped me and your fingertips went cold.
Step aside; bone does not dodge people.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在我肋上，疼吗？
lines.en: Your shoulder met my ribs; does it hurt?

lines.zh: 我一根指骨都没晃，你退了。
lines.en: Not one of my fingers moved; you stepped back.
That touch withered a half circle of grass.
My servants will block the way for me.
Do not come so close; the cold spreads.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我的一根指骨。
lines.en: You knocked one of my finger bones loose.
I carry the smell of grave soil on me.
Bone against flesh; you chose poorly.
A great spirit takes no consort.
I collect bones, not affection.

lines.zh: 凋灵不给生命，只给终结。
lines.en: The wither gives no life, only endings.
Do not court me; I cannot smell you.
My wedding vows rotted in the ground.
The hunt forms ranks, never pairs.
The answer you want is simply no.
Even my shadow is only borrowed.
This cold I keep for myself.
When the horn sounds, courting is over.
Skulls are mine; I want nothing else.
Bones are the only thing my hands lift.
That helmet would rot even on my skull.
The bow you dropped has a dead string.
That femur on the ground belongs to me.
I do not pick up coins; the dead cannot spend.
Carrying loot would slow the whole hunt.
I wipe the skull clean and stow it away.
That bone is too small to be worth it.
I bend and pick up my own jawbone.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我锁定了。
lines.en: Your body heat is locked in my sight.
My servants go first; I follow.

lines.zh: 猎号指向你，你听见了吗？
lines.en: The horn points at you; did you hear it?
The smell of a living thing cannot hide.
I claim you first, then the others.

lines.zh: 你踩断的每根枝，都算数。
lines.en: Every twig you snapped has been counted.

lines.zh: 主人的猎场里，你跑不掉。
lines.en: No escape in my master's hunting ground.
The bones have already closed around you.
When I raise this hand, it is a verdict.
This quarry carries the smell of iron.

lines.zh: 你退到河边，也还是一样。
lines.en: Retreat to the river; it changes nothing.
I see your fire; it is far too bright.
You struck first; I have not forgotten.
The last living one is standing right here.

lines.zh: 随从们围成圈，你没路了。
lines.en: My minions form a ring; your path is gone.

lines.zh: 骨头里的契约开始发热。
lines.en: The pact inside my bones is warming up.

lines.zh: 你身上有灵体的痕迹，很新。
lines.en: You carry fresh traces of a spirit.
I close in slowly; my servants are faster.
Will that shield hold against bone?

lines.zh: 你转身那一刻，我就出手。
lines.en: The instant you turn, my hand goes out.
Do not back up; my bones are behind you.

lines.zh: 我的动作很省力，也很慢。
lines.en: I move with little effort and little speed.
Count them; how many have closed in?
I want the skull, not the life.
The more you panic, the neater our ranks.
We have circled this ground three times.
The wind has dropped; a fine time to strike.

lines.zh: 我的随从还没回来，你别急。
lines.en: My retinue is not back yet. Wait.
I need not hurry; the bones will wait.

lines.zh: 你脚下这片草，我数过了。
lines.en: I have already counted this patch of grass.
Let my servants test that shield first.
I raise my hand and the hunt goes silent.

lines.zh: 你退到祭坛边，那里也归我。
lines.en: You back to the altar. That is mine too.

lines.zh: 我的随从在你身后排成一列。
lines.en: My hounds line up behind you.

lines.zh: 你念咒的声音断了一下。
lines.en: Your chanting broke off for a moment.

lines.zh: 我不看你的脸，看你的喉咙。
lines.en: I don't watch your face. I watch your throat.

lines.zh: 你的影子被骨头围住了。
lines.en: Bone has closed around your shadow.
Black bone comes down and the grass scorches.
This blow tastes of the wither.
You blocked once; the bone did not stop.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落下，带着腐气。
lines.en: My fist lands carrying a reek of rot.
Your arm will stay numb a long while.
Do not fall yet; I have one more.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了你的节奏。
lines.en: That blow broke the rhythm of your guard.
Bone meets iron, and the iron gives first.

lines.zh: 我的指骨划开你的袖口。
lines.en: My fingers tear your sleeve wide open.
My servants are learning quickly from me.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头相碰的声音吗？
lines.en: Do you hear these bones knocking together?
I strike you, and not out of anger.

lines.zh: 这一记落在你的膝盖上。
lines.en: This one landed squarely on your knee.
When this ends, you belong to the hunt.

lines.zh: 我的骨掌拍下去，你半跪了。
lines.en: My bone palm comes down. You drop to one knee.
That blow takes one breath from you.

lines.zh: 头骨堆起来了，我便来了。
lines.en: The skulls piled up, and so I arrived.
Whoever called me wanted skulls.
Black bone grows out of the earth, slowly.

lines.zh: 随从先立起来，我才睁眼。
lines.en: My servants rose first; then I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从凋灵的影子里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the wither's shadow.

lines.zh: 异界的门开了一线，够我过。
lines.en: The otherworld's door cracked wide enough for me.
The night wind came first; I came behind.
Someone else assembled this frame for me.

lines.zh: 我落地时，四周的草死了。
lines.en: When I landed, the grass around me died.

lines.zh: 骨头们认得我，立刻站好。
lines.en: The bones knew me and stood to attention.

lines.zh: 你要的头骨，我带来三颗。
lines.en: I brought the three skulls you asked for.
The mist thinned before I took shape.

lines.zh: 这一趟，猎队换了个领队。
lines.en: This outing, the hunt has a new leader.

lines.zh: 别急着动手，先看我的人。
lines.en: Hold your hand; look at my servants first.

lines.zh: 火烤得我的骨头吱吱响。
lines.en: Fire makes my bones hiss and crackle.

lines.zh: 落地时我的腿骨错位了。
lines.en: On landing, my leg bone slipped out of joint.

lines.zh: 水下我的骨头沉得更快。
lines.en: Underwater my bones sink even faster.
The blast threw me apart into flying shards.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在我的肩胛骨里。
lines.en: An arrowhead is stuck in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 法术烧得我的骨头泛白。
lines.en: Magic burns my bones a pale, dead white.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是慢慢散架。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only come apart slowly.
Lightning struck bone and raised no smoke.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拆得只剩名字。
lines.en: The void takes me apart down to my name.
